subject: GPU release wave & committed capacity calendar — AegisAI term negotiation
messages:
From: Sofia Rinaldi <sofia@aegisai.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@aegisai.com
Date: 2027-02-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: RFP: phased Dedicated capacity plan (24–36 mo) — preliminary numbers

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week. Attached is our ramp specs spreadsheet (Aegis_Ramp_Specs.xlsx) — high level ask below:

- Timeline: 36 months preferred, open to 24
- Wave 1 (M0): 20 GPUs + 50 TPM baseline
- Wave 2 (M6): +40 GPUs (total 60) + 150 TPM
- Wave 3 (M13): +100 GPUs (total 160) + 400 TPM
- Requirement: dedicated pools, predictable throughput, and regional failover
- Commercial ask: annual vs 3-year prepay pricing + term discount matrix; upfront vs annual amortization; preferred invoice triggers tied to wave acceptance

Can you provide an initial term sheet with pricing bands for annual prepay and 3-year prepay, suggested ramp schedule with invoice milestones, and any options for front-loaded credits or conversion credits if we accelerate growth?

Procurement is on copy. We'd like prelim numbers by EOD 2027-02-17 and a working call next week.

Best,

Sofia Rinaldi
Head of Infrastructure
AegisAI

Attachment: Aegis_Ramp_Specs.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Rinaldi <sofia@aegisai.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-12T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: phased Dedicated capacity plan (24–36 mo) — preliminary numbers

Sofia —

Thanks for the spec and timeline. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Lauren (pricing) to put together a concise term sheet. We can support both annual and 3-year prepay structures; common patterns we've seen:

- 12-mo annual prepaid: lower discount (typical ~12–18%) with annual true-ups
- 36-mo prepaid: deeper discount (we can look at 20–26% depending on commit size)
- Front-load credits: 1–3 months of reduced billing if you prepay up front during onboarding
- Conversion credit: if you accelerate and convert reserved GPU->more GPUs, we can apply a growth credit against remaining commit

I've attached an initial draft term sheet (Redwood_Dedicated_TermSheet_v1.pdf) with an example ramp calendar and suggested invoice triggers (milestone: provisioning, acceptance test, and wave launch). Can we do a 30-min call Tuesday 2027-02-15 or Thursday 2027-02-17? Ben / Lauren, please propose numbers and any alternatives (TPM-as-credit, smoothing of payments).

Thanks —

Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Dedicated_TermSheet_v1.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Rinaldi <sofia@aegisai.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-17T13:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: phased Dedicated capacity plan (24–36 mo) — preliminary numbers

Hi Sofia — appreciate the details. Following up from our call today, below is our preliminary commercial structure to start discussion (numbers illustrative, final in v2 term sheet):

1) Discount matrix (applies to compute unit list price):
   - Annual prepay (12-mo): 15% discount on GPU list
   - 36-mo prepay (3-yr): 22% discount on GPU list
   - TPM bundled: additional 5% off TPM unit price when purchased with GPU commit

2) Onboarding credits / growth cushions:
   - Front-load credit: equal to 2 months of baseline bill applied during first 6 months if prepaid up front
   - Early-conversion credit: 10% of incremental spend credited if you convert within first 12 months

3) Ramp / invoicing proposal:
   - Invoice A (Provisioning): 30% of Year 1 committed dollars to signal capacity
   - Invoice B (Acceptance): 40% upon successful acceptance test for Wave 1
   - Invoice C (Wave launches): remaining billed per wave at launch (pro rata)
   - For multi-year prepay: annual renewal invoices can be amortized monthly for visibility

4) SLOs and capacity guarantees:
   - Target p99 latency SLO and minimum reserved throughput guarantees per GPU class; formal SLOs in enterprise addendum

Next steps: Lauren will draft v2 term sheet with concrete $/GPU and TPM rates and stress-test your ramp cadence. We can be flexible on payment smoothing if you prefer predictable monthly amortization instead of tranches.

Cheers,

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Procure Ops <procure@aegisai.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: sofia@aegisai.com, cfo@aegisai.com
Date: 2027-02-24T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: phased Dedicated capacity plan (24–36 mo) — preliminary numbers

Hi Grace / Ben,

Thanks for the draft. A few points from procurement / finance and Sofia:

- Discount: 22% is in the ballpark but we need 26% on a 3-year prepaid commit to hit internal hurdle rates. Can Redwood bridge (e.g., 24% base + 2% achievement based on usage milestones)?
- Invoicing: we prefer tranche-based invoicing tied to wave acceptance (we will not accept a large provisioning invoice without an explicit acceptance checklist)
- Capacity SLO: must include regional failover (us-east/us-west) and a clear remediation credit table
- TPM accounting: we want a TPM credit pool rather than per-TPM billing — ringfenced credits that auto-apply against generation overages

Attached: Aegis_Procurement_Contacts.csv (for legal/procurement team) — please include legal in the next version of the term sheet and send DocuSign link for signature-ready copy.

Procurement is pushing for a decision by first week of March.

Regards,

Procure Ops
AegisAI

Attachment: Aegis_Procurement_Contacts.csv (CSV, 2KB)

- 36-mo prepaid effective discount: 24% base off GPU list + up to 6% earnout (applied as credits) tied to two growth milestones (usage band at 12 months and 24 months). This results in up to 30% at target growth.
- If Aegis signs within this calendar quarter and prepays Year 1 upfront, we will add a 1-month onboarding credit on top of the front-load credit described earlier.
- We will change invoicing terms to tranche-based tied to Wave acceptance checklist (Provisioning -> Acceptance -> Launch) per your preference; legal will take the enterprise addendum for SLOs and regional failover language.
- TPM: we'll provide a TPM credit pool structure — details in v2 term sheet (credits auto-apply; overages billed monthly)

Attached is Redwood_Dedicated_TermSheet_v2.pdf with revised pricing bands and a ramp calendar that maps dates to Wave launches and invoice triggers.
